name: Summer at Tower
description_short: Day camp on Tower School's 8 acre campus in Marblehead for ages 2 years 9 months through entering grade 9, in nine one week themed sessions. Younger groups choose half days (8 to 1) or full days (8 to 4) with pool swim lessons; older campers get field trips, a three week design workshop and a leaders in training program.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Overview page: nine one week sessions from June 22, 2026, Monday to Friday; ages 2 years 9 months through entering grade 9; half day 8 to 1 or full day 8 to 4 for younger groups, full day only for grades 5 to 9; pool swim lessons for younger groups; the page states Summer at Tower is accredited by the American Camp Association. age_max derived from entering grade 9; minimum age 2 years 9 months is not recorded as age_min because it is not a whole year. Indoor and outdoor inferred from the campus, pool and wetlands activities.

Researched by Claude from this page. Explorers page (entering K and 1), 2026: weeks 1 to 9 from June 22 to August 21; full day $525 a week ($420 for the four day week of June 29), half day $396 ($317). Sessions use the Explorers full day price. price_min is the 17 half day rate for the short week.

Researched by Claude from this page. Pathfinders (entering grades 5 to 8), 2026: 77 a week, the highest weekly rate across groups; 3 week design workshop ,730. Other pages: Adventurers 48 half and 66 full; L.I.T. bootcamp week 78 with a 00 non-refundable deposit.
